summary.en: The Commission suspended some rural-development payments to one company group over potential conflicts of interest; one beneficiary's payments are not measured by any held indicator.
summary.zh: 欧盟委员会因潜在利益冲突暂停向一家企业集团支付部分农村发展资金；单一受益方的付款不由任何已持有指标衡量。

summary.en: The Commission President announced €50 million for a Black Sea maritime security hub; an announcement with no cited decision.
summary.zh: 欧盟委员会主席宣布为黑海海上安全中心提供 5000 万欧元；宣布时未引用任何决定。

summary.en: A negotiating position on the next EU long-term budget.

summary.en: A negotiating position on the 2028–2034 multiannual financial framework.
summary.zh: 关于 2028—2034 年多年期财政框架的谈判立场。

summary.en: A national position on the next EU budget; the €7 billion net figure is the prime minister's statement about a proposal under negotiation.
summary.zh: 关于下一期欧盟预算的国家立场；70 亿欧元净额是总理对谈判中方案的说法。

summary.en: A reaction to a reported letter on the EU budget; no decision.
summary.zh: 对报道中关于欧盟预算信函的回应；没有决定。

summary.en: A joint declaration asking for EU funds to support industry; a position, not a funding decision.
summary.zh: 要求欧盟资金支持工业的联合声明；是立场，不是资金决定。

summary.en: A summit statement on coordinating EU agenda positions; the funding and fiscal indicators coded on the event record have no relationship to it.
summary.zh: 关于协调欧盟议程立场的峰会声明；事件记录编码的资金和财政指标与之没有关系。

summary.en: A minister's statement on recovering about €10 billion of EU recovery funds, sourced to a non-specific category page.
summary.zh: 部长关于争取收回约 100 亿欧元欧盟复苏资金的表态，来源为非特定的栏目页面。

note.en: Serbia is not an EU member state: EU-internal programmes are not applicable (not zero); IPA funds are not held.
note.zh: 塞尔维亚不是欧盟成员国：欧盟内部计划不适用（不是零）；未持有 IPA 资金数据。

summary.en: Company announcement of a €7.34 billion investment, 100 GWh planned capacity and a 221-hectare site.
summary.zh: 企业公告 73.4 亿欧元投资、规划产能 100 吉瓦时和 221 公顷用地。

summary.en: Government Resolution 1415/2022 budgets HUF 87.7 billion from the central budget for grid works serving the Southern Economic Zone (zone infrastructure, not support to the investor).
summary.zh: 第 1415/2022 号政府决议从中央预算安排 877 亿福林用于南部经济区电网工程（属园区基础设施，不是对投资者的支持）。

summary.en: Government Decree 323/2022 replaces the special building rules and boundary of the Debrecen site, a priority case of national economic importance; the decree does not name the investor.
summary.zh: 第 323/2022 号政府法令替换德布勒森园区的特别建筑规则和边界，该园区属于具有国家经济意义的重点事项；法令未点名投资者。

summary.en: Project announcement reported by a news agency; no investment amount is recorded.
summary.zh: 通讯社报道项目宣布；未记录投资额。

summary.en: The economy ministry announced a €1.2 billion battery investment.
summary.zh: 经济部宣布 12 亿欧元电池投资。

summary.en: Unified environmental use permit, modified after a significant-change review; permitted cell capacity 40 GWh a year.
summary.zh: 统一环境使用许可经重大变更审查后修改；许可电芯产能每年 40 吉瓦时。

summary.en: Memorandum of understanding with the government to support construction, as published by the company.
summary.zh: 企业发布的与政府签署的支持建设谅解备忘录。

summary.en: Fourth permit amendment: cell capacity 40.7 GWh, module and pack assembly 18.9 GWh, total 59.6 GWh a year; no final industrial-safety permit yet.
summary.zh: 第四次许可修改：电芯产能 40.7 吉瓦时，模组和电池包组装 18.9 吉瓦时，合计每年 59.6 吉瓦时；尚无最终工业安全许可。

summary.en: Occupancy permit granted for the first phase of the cell-manufacturing building; the second phase was refused on 19 August.
summary.zh: 电芯制造厂房一期获得使用许可；二期于 8 月 19 日被拒。

summary.en: The company reports module manufacturing since autumn 2024 (537,000 modules) and trial cell production from 22 September 2026; the authority prohibited work in three areas after nickel-exposure findings.
summary.zh: 企业称自 2024 年秋起制造模组（53.7 万个），2026 年 9 月 22 日起试生产电芯；主管机关因镍暴露问题禁止三个区域作业。

summary.en: The environmental permit is the subject of an administrative court case; no judgment text has been published.
summary.zh: 环境许可是一宗行政诉讼的标的；尚未公布判决文本。

summary.en: A HUF 25 billion programme announced for 2027 on social media by the minister.
summary.zh: 部长在社交媒体宣布 2027 年启动 250 亿福林计划。

summary.en: No official record of public support to the investor was located; the 2022 letter of intent published in 2026 lists promised support but is non-binding.
summary.zh: 未找到对投资者公共支持的官方记录；2026 年公开的 2022 年意向书列出承诺的支持，但不具约束力。

summary.en: No official record of capital invested, employment or series production at the plant was located.
summary.zh: 未找到工厂实际投资、就业或批量生产的官方记录。

summary.zh: 未记录许可。

summary.en: No production record is held.
summary.zh: 未持有生产记录。

summary.zh: 未记录政府法令或预算拨款。

summary.en: Public support amounts and the equity structure are not recorded.
summary.zh: 未记录公共支持金额和股权结构。

summary.en: No construction record is held.
summary.zh: 未持有建设记录。

summary.en: USD 350 million capital increase paid for a 63% stake; the separate USD 1.26 billion six-year investment commitment is a commitment, not realised spending.
summary.zh: 支付 3.5 亿美元增资取得 63% 股权；另有 12.6 亿美元六年投资承诺，属于承诺而非已实现支出。

summary.en: First-phase investment estimated by the government at USD 1 billion; a later €645 million plan is a separate phase.
summary.zh: 政府估计第一阶段投资 10 亿美元；之后的 6.45 亿欧元计划属于另一阶段。

summary.en: Groundbreaking in 2019 and main construction from 2020.
summary.zh: 2019 年奠基，2020 年起主体建设。

summary.en: Serial production of tyres began in 2024.
summary.zh: 2024 年开始批量生产轮胎。

summary.en: The exploration licence was renewed in late September 2026, as reported from the company's exchange announcement.
summary.zh: 据企业交易所公告报道，勘探许可于 2026 年 9 月下旬续期。

summary.en: Sale of the project to Middle Island Resources for AU$300,000 in cash or shares, with a 1% net smelter return royalty retained by the seller.
summary.zh: 以 30 万澳元现金或股票将项目出售给 Middle Island Resources，卖方保留 1% 冶炼净收益权益金。

summary.en: RTB Bor was an operating mining and smelting company before the partnership; the transaction transferred control and management rather than starting production.
summary.zh: 合作前 RTB Bor 已是运营中的采矿和冶炼企业；交易转移的是控制权和管理权，而不是开始生产。

summary.en: Mine and smelter output is not held; the national industrial production index covers mining, manufacturing and energy together.

summary.en: No mining (exploitation) permit is recorded.

summary.en: REPowerEU grants in the assessed plan, plus a separate €55 million transfer from the Brexit Adjustment Reserve.
summary.zh: 评估计划中的 REPowerEU 赠款，另有 5500 万欧元脱欧调整储备转入。

summary.en: Modified recovery plan as assessed by the Commission: €8.4 billion grants and €818 million loans (rounded as published).
summary.zh: 委员会评估的修订复苏计划：赠款 84 亿欧元、贷款 8.18 亿欧元（按发布数字取整）。

summary.en: REPowerEU pre-financing paid by the Commission.
summary.zh: 委员会支付的 REPowerEU 预付款。

summary.en: Non-repayable support to be paid after clearing pre-financing, under decision C(2024) 9258; a further €190.9 million first loan instalment is authorised separately.
summary.zh: 依据 C(2024) 9258 决定，扣除预付款后应支付的非偿还性支持；另单独授权第一期贷款 1.909 亿欧元。

summary.en: First loan instalment authorised under decision C(2024) 9258.

summary.zh: 第五笔付款。

summary.en: Sixth payment.
summary.zh: 第六笔付款。

summary.zh: 第七次即最后一次付款申请，2026 年 8 月 31 日提交，委员会于 2026 年 10 月 29 日作出积极初步评估；尚未支付。

summary.en: Council measures restricting new EU-budget legal commitments with public-interest trusts and the entities they maintain, as explained by the Commission on 26 January 2023.
summary.zh: 理事会措施限制与公共利益信托及其维持实体签署新的欧盟预算法律承诺，委员会于 2023 年 1 月 26 日作出说明。

summary.en: Part of the fifth instalment suspended for REPowerEU grid milestone 304 (decision C(2024) 9246); lifted on 21 November 2025.

summary.en: Grant payment net of pre-financing; €41 million of loans were paid the same day and are recorded separately.

summary.zh: 贷款付款。

summary.zh: 首笔付款报道中所述罗马尼亚 SAFE 贷款总额度。

summary.en: First SAFE loan payment (15% of the envelope).
summary.zh: SAFE 首笔贷款付款（额度的 15%）。

summary.zh: 最后一笔付款申请的赠款部分；仍在评估中。

summary.zh: 最后一笔付款申请的贷款部分；仍在评估中。

summary.en: Final payment request including grants and loans; the amount is not stated in the record.
summary.zh: 包括赠款和贷款的最后一笔付款申请；记录未载明金额。

summary.en: First SAFE loan payment, about 15% of a €2 billion allocation.
summary.zh: SAFE 首笔贷款付款，约为 20 亿欧元额度的 15%。

summary.en: The Council ended the procedure; Erasmus+ grant agreements were signed again.
summary.zh: 理事会终止该程序；伊拉斯谟+资助协议重新签署。

summary.en: Water-infrastructure contract for the island of Vir, co-financed by the Competitiveness and Cohesion Programme; the contract value is not the EU share.
summary.zh: 维尔岛供水基础设施合同，由竞争力和凝聚力计划共同资助；合同金额不是欧盟出资部分。

summary.en: 22 water-supply and wastewater contracts funded by the recovery plan in 13 counties; the government gives about €275 million for all water contracts signed that day, including the Vir contract below, without a separate total for these 22.
summary.zh: 13 个县的 22 份由复苏计划资助的供水和污水合同；政府给出的当天全部水务合同约 2.75 亿欧元包括下方的维尔岛合同，未单列这 22 份的合计。
